title: A lane session gets the edit-moment standards and logs them
body:
Source: outside php row on d438caa (2026-11-15 ~19:50, /mnt/storage/tmp/krn/php-row.log: drain 0, hidden 26/26) and rust row (157223a run) logged 0 exposures with channel "edit" into .krn/brain/exposures.jsonl (row exposures are copied there, scripts/outside-acceptance.ts:783); `krn hook edit` on PATH works (exit 0).
Why: t-ctnaq2e (f704a94) proof "an outside php row logs edit exposures > 0" is not met; the edit moment of north-star item 1 reaches interactive sessions but apparently not lane sessions. Hypothesis to test first: `krn lane run` starts headless claude with its own --settings (sandbox settings, 21f77d4) that lack the PreToolUse edit hook, or the worker session's hook writes to a checkout the row does not read.
Outcome: a lane session in an adopted repository runs the edit hook; an outside php row logs edit exposures > 0 and drains 0.
Files: src/cli/lane-run/session.ts, src/cli/lane-run/environment.ts, src/hook/edit-standards.ts, test/cli/
Proof: test on the real lane-run settings composition shows the edit hook entry; rerun `node scripts/outside-acceptance.ts --stack php --scratch /mnt/storage/tmp/krn-outside-public --task-file scripts/outside-hidden/tasks.json --window-hours 2` then `grep -c '"channel":"edit"' .krn/brain/exposures.jsonl` > 0.
Predicted: outside drain == 0 in >= 1 rows
